llm.summary: The skill's instructions are coherent with its stated goal (propagating workspace capability changes) but they instruct cross-session propagation and writing/logging of workspace files without explicit safeguards for sensitive data or permission checks, which could lead to accidental information leakage or unwanted notifications.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the runtime instructions: detecting new tools/packages, updating TOOLS.md, creating/updating SKILL.md, writing memory logs, and notifying sessions are all consistent with a cross-channel propagation helper. The lack of required env vars/binaries and no install spec is proportional to an instruction-only coordination skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md directs the agent to create/modify workspace files (TOOLS.md, SKILL.md, scripts/, memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md) and to 'propagate to active related sessions/agents' (via a 'sessions_send' style sync). There are no explicit guardrails about redacting secrets, obtaining user consent before broadcasting, or verifying channel/session permissions. That broad write-and-broadcast scope increases risk of accidental disclosure or spam across channels.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec or code files — lowest install risk. Nothing is downloaded or written by a packaged installer.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested — appropriate. However, the skill instructs writing free-form records (TOOLS.md, memory logs, scripts) which can easily include secrets or provider-specific invocation commands; the SKILL.md does not require or suggest redaction or validation of sensitive content before propagation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not 'always:true' and is user-invocable. It does permit autonomous model invocation (default), which combined with instructions to notify other sessions increases blast radius if the agent acts without explicit user confirmation. The SKILL.md lacks a step that checks recipient session relevance/consent before sending.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill does what it says (track workspace capability changes and propagate them), but it can write and broadcast workspace state to other sessions. Before installing: 1) Decide whether automatic cross-session notifications are acceptable in your workspace. 2) Require explicit confirmation before sending updates to other channels/sessions. 3) Add redaction rules or checks to avoid storing or broadcasting secrets (API keys, private paths, full install commands containing credentials). 4) Audit any SKILL.md or scripts the agent writes before they are used. 5) If you want to reduce risk, disable autonomous invocation (so the agent cannot run this workflow without your explicit prompt) or restrict who/which sessions receive propagated messages.
